name: zeviro-agency
description: Zeviro.agency — public website, Admin Dashboard/CRM and Client Portal (MERN)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.deploy: npm run install:all && npm run build && pm2 startOrReload deploy/ecosystem.config.cjs
scripts.render-build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
